parsed.scene_description: A supermarket aisle with a person browsing produce. Overhead fluorescent lights illuminate shelves stocked with packaged goods. Hanging paper lanterns decorate the ceiling. A fruit display holds oranges and tangerines.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Individual wearing white long-sleeved shirt and dark pants standing in aisle, facing left toward produce display.

objects.label: fruit display stand
objects.observation: Metal or plastic structure holding baskets of citrus fruit on the left side of the frame.

objects.label: shelves
objects.observation: Multi-tiered shelving units on the right filled with various boxed and packaged food items.

objects.label: paper lanterns
objects.observation: Several hanging decorative paper lanterns suspended from the black ceiling beams.
